QuestInfo.name: More Omens of Collapse
QuestInfo.0: There is a new request from #b#p1531011##k at the Magician Association. Go speak with #b#p1531011##k.
QuestInfo.1: The dimensional collapse discovered in Aqua Road is occurring near Ariant as well. Go check out the area and help put up the barriers.
QuestInfo.2: You've helped keep disaster at bay, but the only way this is going to end is if you enter the sinkhole to remove the root of the issue. Reach Lv. 100 through training.
